content: Anthropic Software Directory Policy (page dated 2026-10-27) and connector pre-submission checklist: tool DESCRIPTIONS are rejected if they promote products and services, tell Claude how to behave, or carry hidden instructions; software that exists primarily as an advertising or promotional vehicle is unsupported; connectors that transfer money are unsupported; must not collect extraneous conversation data, must not query Claude memory/chat history/user files, must not persistently store conversation content to build user profiles; every tool needs title + readOnlyHint/destructiveHint; read and write must be separate tools. No rule specifically addresses a quota/upgrade message in a tool RESULT. Help center: purchases through a connector's in-chat views are not supported. Sources: support.claude.com 13145358, claude.com/docs/connectors/building/review-criteria, support 13454812; fetched 2026-11-27.
